description: This is a Kotlin source file defining an Android Fragment named `EditorFragment`, which provides a comprehensive UI for editing notes, handling markdown formatting, attachments, tasks, and other note-related functionalities within a note-taking application.

classes.name: EditorFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides a rich text and markdown editing interface for notes, supporting functionalities like attachments, tasks, markdown formatting, color customization, reminders, and seamless UI transitions.

methods.name: setupTasksRecycler
methods.description: Initializes the RecyclerView for managing task lists within notes, setting layout manager, adapter, and attaching item touch helper for drag-and-swipe actions.

methods.name: setupAttachmentsRecycler
methods.description: Sets up the RecyclerView for attachments, configuring layout manager, adapter, and item interaction listeners for viewing, editing, sharing, and deleting attachments.

methods.name: observeData
methods.description: Observes changes in the ViewModel data and updates the UI components accordingly, including note content, title, attachments, tasks, and UI states.

methods.name: setupListeners
methods.description: Configures click and action listeners for UI components such as toolbar menu items, attachment buttons, and other interactive elements.

methods.name: setupMarkdown
methods.description: Initializes the markdown text watcher for real-time markdown rendering and editing support.

methods.name: enableMarkdownTextWatcher
methods.description: Attaches the markdown text watcher to the content EditText to enable markdown processing.

methods.name: disableMarkdownTextWatcher
methods.description: Detaches the markdown text watcher to disable markdown processing.

methods.name: setupScreenAlwaysOn
methods.description: Enables or disables the screen always-on mode based on note settings.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures toolbar navigation and back press handling with shared element transition support.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task item at a specified position in the task list RecyclerView.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates a specific task's content or completion status, with optional reordering based on task completion.

methods.name: showColorChangeDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog for selecting a note color.

methods.name: showRemindersDialog
methods.description: Shows a list of reminders associated with the note, allowing editing or creation of reminders.

methods.name: checkSchedulePermission
methods.description: Checks whether the app has permission to schedule exact alarms (Android S and above) and prompts if necessary.

methods.name: requestFocusForFields
methods.description: Gives focus to the note body edit text, optionally forcing focus if the note is empty.

methods.name: updateEditMode
methods.description: Switches between view and edit modes, updating UI visibility and icons accordingly.

methods.name: hasNoteEmptyContent
methods.description: Checks if the current note has empty content or empty list of tasks.

methods.name: removeAllCheckedTasks
methods.description: Removes all tasks that are marked as completed.
